added: Contra figures can name the threes and fours as their dancers, for triplets, triple minors and four-couple dances. Dances you import from The Caller's Box read "Threes" and "Fours" as those couples, and a single dancer such as "Woman one" as the first robin (in your own dialect's words).
Add the `threes` and `fours` dancer sets to the contra vocabulary (taxonomy v40), and read The Caller's Box's `role2 one`-style dancer names as the single-dancer tokens.
